title: T9 — Closure review
body:
# T9 — Closure review

Project: T9 — TOGAF ADM capability · Track: v2 · Tranche: 4 · Plan: docs/SPEC_V2.md §12 / docs/plans/T9-architecture-capability.md
Unit: #387 (the unit that publishes this output)
Measured at: main@36b9b60d, 2026-11-19 · Project row: closed

## Outcome vs acceptance

The acceptance set is `docs/plans/T9-architecture-capability.md` §5, D1–D6. An independent compliance review — not the documents' author — recorded its verdicts on 2026-11-19 against the live statement of architecture work: approval `01a1f357-69eb-7716-811e-ce22ea93d496`, level compliant. The table restates those verdicts with the evidence at `36b9b60d`.

| Criterion | Evidence | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| D1 — The artefact standard and repository | `migrations/0054_architecture.sql` — `artifact_type`, `architecture_artifact`, `architecture_artifact_entry`, `architecture_artifact_link`; `crates/actions/src/architecture.rs` — `artifacts_*` and `repository_search`; `crates/api/tests/architecture_artifacts.rs::a_catalog_is_queryable_rows`, `::an_approved_artefact_is_immutable`, `::reuse_is_searchable_across_plateaus` | pass |
| D2 — The Preliminary capability | `adm_profile`, `governance_body`, `architecture_maturity`, `architecture_skill_assessment`; `crates/api/tests/architecture_capability.rs::the_profile_names_the_mandatory_set`, `::a_maturity_assessment_needs_every_dimension`, `::a_skills_assessment_names_its_role`, `::maturity_list_returns_every_assessment_dimension`, `::skills_list_returns_one_entry_per_role`; live adoption rows read back 2026-11-19 | pass — the service exposes only the write actions, so the maturity and skills rows are cited from the live read-back |
| D3 — The architecture project and its phase gates | `crates/api/tests/togaf_architecture_phases.rs::phases_a_to_f_pass_in_order`, `::a_draft_artefact_refuses_the_contract`, `::a_contract_change_reopens_the_gate` | pass — tests only; no live phase advance has run |
| D4 — Delivery compliance | `crates/api/tests/togaf_delivery_design_gate.rs::a_delivery_project_without_a_contract_cannot_pass_design`, `::a_superseded_contract_refuses_design`, `::a_live_contract_opens_the_design_gate`; `crates/api/tests/architecture_compliance.rs::one_level_and_a_dated_waiver`; the live compliant review row | pass |
| D5 — Change management | `crates/api/tests/togaf_h_change.rs::a_scope_change_produces_a_change_register_row`, `::an_unrecorded_review_refuses_the_gate` | pass — with the finding that the plan-named `a_systemic_finding_produces_a_kata_candidate` does not exist; the substance sits inside `a_scope_change_produces_a_change_register_row` |
| D6 — The console surface and the seed | `apps/web/src/screens/architecture.rs` — four tabs, live invokes, phase-advance refusal — routed at `/architecture` in `apps/web/src/app.rs`; `docs/design/v2.js` Architecture destination; check-v2 248 checks | pass |

One correction to the review record. The reviewer wrote that the public snapshot already carried an `architecture` section. Measured after the review, `https://conveyor.nonagentic.ai/design/data/snapshot.js` returned `git_sha ba70b428` with no `architecture` section, and the three read actions were not registered live. PR #401 is merged at `36b9b60d`, but its image had not rolled at the time of writing. D6 is unaffected: its criterion is the app's Architecture screen, live since `c8204432`. The snapshot section is an additional surface, delivered by #401; the image roll and its live verification are pending.

## Evidence

- PR #350, merge `c8204432` (2026-11-18) — the capability, its 26 actions and the app's Architecture screen; issue #81 closed 2026-11-18.
- PR #401, merge `36b9b60d` (2026-11-19) — `architecture.maturity_list`, `architecture.skills_list`, `architecture.board_list`, the snapshot section and the pack destination; issue #385.
- `migrations/0054_architecture.sql` — eleven tenant-scoped, FORCE-RLS tables; present at `main@36b9b60d`.
- `crates/actions/src/architecture.rs` — 29 registered actions; `crates/store/src/architecture.rs` — the invariants and the write/read paths; `crates/store/src/snapshot.rs` — the public `architecture` section, filtered to programme-bound projects.
- Tests: the seventeen scenarios cited in the table, plus `crates/api/tests/architecture_capability.rs::board_list_returns_the_opened_body`; `crates/actions/tests/parity_http_mcp.rs` and `registry.rs` carry the new actions.
- Adoption: profile `conveyor-software-delivery` v3; PF-1 catalogue with 10 entries approved v2; derivation 7 edges and realization 10 edges linked; statement of architecture work live v2; maturity group mean 2.2/5; skills group six roles, 42 rows. Ten documents published under unit #387.
- CI: PR #401's required contexts succeeded; merge_group `ci` run 44501468428 succeeded, then merged.
- The project's published `evidence` document carries the same evidence; this review adds no proof beyond it.

## Open items

Each disclosed gap is carried here, not treated as satisfied. No open issue in the queue names these specific gaps (`gh issue list --repo nonagenticai/conveyor --state all --search 'architecture OR T9'`, 2026-11-19); each owner claims before starting.

1. PF-1 artefact document link — owner: project owner (decision); next step: decide the supersede plus fresh board approval, then set `document_id` to the published principles page.
2. Type-create and E–H sets — owner: architecture capability follow-up; next step: an action that adds an artefact type, mandatory sets for phases E–H, and a non-empty Phase E requirement set.
3. Board lifecycle — owner: architecture capability follow-up; next step: a transition action so an approved board leaves `draft` (#395 concerns board/contract coverage, not this transition).
4. Duplicate assessment group `01a1f2ca-fdf6-7698-b685-e1e94dd454be` — owner: architecture capability follow-up; next step: add an assessment delete or supersede action, then remove the duplicate.
5. Pack writes — owner: design-pack unit; next step: decide whether the pack must write; if so, a separate unit. The app screen remains the write surface.
6. D5 selector correction — owner: plan and test owner; next step: implement `a_systemic_finding_produces_a_kata_candidate` or amend the plan to the existing selector, which covers the substance.
7. Lifecycle event literals — owner: architecture capability follow-up; next step: find or add the emission sites for `architecture_artifact.changed`, `architecture_phase.closed`, `compliance_review.recorded` and `architecture_waiver.granted`, assert one in a test, or correct the plan's event claim.
8. Live phase advance — owner: architecture project owner; next step: exercise one advance on a real architecture project and record the trace, closing D3's tests-only status.
9. Image roll and live verification — owner: the release path for #401; next step: roll the image, then verify the snapshot contains the `architecture` section and the three read actions register live.

## Decision

T9 is closed (status `closed`); its build unit #81 closed on 2026-11-18, and the project's closure is confirmed by this review at `36b9b60d`. It records the close and does not grant a new approval. All six acceptance criteria stand as pass on the compliance reviewer's verdicts, with three findings recorded rather than hidden: D3 has no live phase advance, D5's plan-named selector is absent while its substance is covered, and the reviewer's D6 snapshot claim did not hold — D6 itself is unaffected because its criterion is the app's Architecture screen, live since `c8204432`. The capability and the app console are delivered by #350; the read actions, pack destination and snapshot section are delivered by #401; the image roll and its live verification are pending. The gaps above are carried as open items, not treated as satisfied.
